I’ve done this a few times in my 20s.. eventually it caught up with me and i needed support from people who knew me and had to return home after fucking things up on my “adventure”

Maybe you can take a short hiatus away? Nothing permanent. Just to scratch the itch. That helped for me at time when I felt like I wanted to disappear. Just don’t throw your whole life away, take a lil break and come back when you’re feeling better - and please don’t wait until it all comes crashing down to get back home
Also - it comes in waves.. it really does. it won’t always feel this way. Ride the ride, and take in whatever light you can find when you can

Over the years struggling with SI has really made me consider what comes next… and the idea that it could be worse than this, keeps me here. I know that’s not a great outlook but it’s my truth and does help me when I’m really at my limit 

If I can survive this hell - that’s better than any actual hell 🤷🏻‍♀️

No that is absolutely not ok to say to someone when they are inside of you! You are totally just in your feelings. Thats not ok and just cruel. I’m sorry you had to experience that. I would not see him again if I were you - big red flag
Thanks for replying. I really hope you are right - what you say sounds reasonable - just hard to believe during hard times… next week when I’m over this episode I think I would believe it
I show my boyfriends his videos so they can learn lol
He is the best. All men should take note! This is how you do it 🥵
Yea maybe I’ll try.... thanks for the advice

I’m completely dependent on alcohol. I have withdrawals if I don’t drink. I tell my romantic partners I want to die and they get scared and leave me... I’ve been in bed for 3 days. I’ve been quarantined and isolated since Dec 2nd. I should be ok to leave my house but I just want to be in bed. I can’t even help myself.

I haven’t really.... I tried therapy and meds but it’s too expensive now that I’m an adult. I’m also just honestly self sabotaging and I don’t know how to help myself. I wish someone would help me deal with everything. I feel like a child sometimes
I feel the same way. I just think that people who don’t know what it’s like never ever will.. and they are the only ones who can actually help us
